notes: The fail-before control at a forward-merge head restores from the merge base, not from the branch's original fork point: main changed 34 files under packages/dispatch/web/src since 05d6578981a4, including api/client.ts and api/types.ts, which this change also edits, so restoring the whole directory from 05d6578981a4 would undo main's work too and build something that is neither head nor base. `jj restore --from "$(jj log --no-graph -r 'fork_point(main@origin | <head>)' -T commit_id)" packages/dispatch/web/src` undoes this change alone.

Tester harness in this pod: `bun install` at the repository root first (main added micromark-core-commonmark, without which packages/dispatch's build:web fails on packages/proof-editor/src/block-nesting.ts; the install also rewrites bun.lock's pi-envoy and pi-legion versions, drift already on main — restore it with `jj restore bun.lock`), then `cd packages/contracts && bun run build` (Playwright reads @legion/contracts through dist/), `bunx playwright install chromium` with PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH left unset, a database of your own for DATABASE_URL and another for DISPATCH_TEST_DATABASE_URL/BROKER_TEST_DATABASE_URL, and the spec file written before --project. This session's bash shell is shared, so a `set -e` left on by an earlier command aborts the next one silently: `set +e` first.
Every host in this file is the `<tailnet>` placeholder the public-repository rule names, and the gate was run over the tree with this handoff in place before it was committed.
